```{=html}
<script>
// ---- State ----
const S = {
  phase: 'instructions', nQuestions: 5, currentQ: 0,
  questions: [], userOrders: [], revealed: [], scores: [], confidences: [],
  selTags: new Set(), selItems: 4, selNq: 5, allTags: []
};
let quizPool = [];

// ---- Data ----
function loadData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('quiz-data');
  if (!el) return;
  quizPool = JSON.parse(el.textContent);
  // Extract unique tags
  const tags = new Set();
  quizPool.forEach(r => { if (r.tag) tags.add(r.tag); });
  S.allTags = [...tags].sort();
  S.allTags.forEach(t => S.selTags.add(t));
}

// ---- Security helpers ----
function escHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
    return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
  });
}
function safeHref(u) {
  u = String(u || '');
  if (/^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|\/|#)/i.test(u)) return u;
  return '#';
}

// ---- Helpers ----
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function formatName(name) { return name.replace(/\s*\(/, '<br>('); }
function fmtMM(v) {
  if (v >= 100) return Math.round(v).toLocaleString();
  if (v >= 1) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(1)).toString();
  if (v >= 0.01) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(2)).toString();
  return parseFloat(v.toFixed(3)).toString();
}
function lleLabel(lle) {
  const fmt = v => { const s = v.toFixed(1); return s.endsWith('.0') ? s.slice(0,-2) : s; };
  if (lle >= 1440) return fmt(lle / 1440) + ' days';
  if (lle >= 60) return fmt(lle / 60) + ' hrs';
  return fmt(lle) + ' min';
}
function lleDirLabel(item) {
  const mag = escHtml(lleLabel(item.lle_minutes));
  const isGain = item.item_source === 'chronic' &&
                 item.microlives_per_day != null && item.microlives_per_day > 0;
  if (isGain) {
    return `<span class="lle-gain">▲ gain ${mag}</span>`;
  } else {
    return `<span class="lle-loss">▼ lose ${mag}</span>`;
  }
}
function toggleLLEHelp(el) {
  let tip = el.parentElement.querySelector('.lle-help-tip');
  if (tip) { tip.remove(); return; }
  tip = document.createElement('div');
  tip.className = 'lle-help-tip';
  tip.appendChild(document.createTextNode('▲ gain = life added (e.g. exercise). ▼ lose = life shortened (e.g. smoking).'));
  tip.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
  const small = document.createElement('small');
  small.style.color = '#6c757d';
  small.textContent = 'Based on Loss of Life Expectancy (LLE) — the standard metric for comparing risks.';
  tip.appendChild(small);
  el.parentElement.appendChild(tip);
  setTimeout(() => tip.remove(), 5000);
}
function renderQR(containerId, size) {
  const url = window.location.href.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el || typeof qrcode === 'undefined') return;
  const safeSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, parseInt(size, 10) || 3));
  const qr = qrcode(0, 'M');
  qr.addData(url);
  qr.make();
  const img = qr.createImgTag(safeSize);
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'qr-section';
  wrapper.innerHTML = img;
  const urlSpan = document.createElement('span');
  urlSpan.className = 'qr-url';
  urlSpan.textContent = url;
  wrapper.appendChild(urlSpan);
  el.innerHTML = '';
  el.appendChild(wrapper);
}
function selectInGroup(grpId, clicked) {
  const btns = document.getElementById(grpId).querySelectorAll('.option-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  clicked.classList.add('selected');
}
function toggleTag(el) {
  const tag = el.dataset.tag;
  if (S.selTags.has(tag)) { S.selTags.delete(tag); el.classList.remove('selected'); }
  else { S.selTags.add(tag); el.classList.add('selected'); }
}
function selectAllTags(select) {
  const btns = document.getElementById('tag_group').querySelectorAll('.tag-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => {
    const tag = b.dataset.tag;
    if (select) { S.selTags.add(tag); b.classList.add('selected'); }
    else { S.selTags.delete(tag); b.classList.remove('selected'); }
  });
}

// ---- Kendall tau scoring ----
function kendallTau(userOrder, correctOrder) {
  const k = userOrder.length;
  const maxPairs = k * (k - 1) / 2;
  let discordant = 0;
  const userRank = {}, correctRank = {};
  userOrder.forEach((v, i) => userRank[v] = i);
  correctOrder.forEach((v, i) => correctRank[v] = i);
  for (let i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < k; j++) {
      const a = userOrder[i], b = userOrder[j];
      if ((userRank[a] < userRank[b]) !== (correctRank[a] < correctRank[b])) discordant++;
    }
  }
  return { score: maxPairs - discordant, maxScore: maxPairs, pct: Math.round((maxPairs - discordant) / maxPairs * 100) };
}

// ---- Leaderboard (pure JS) ----
const FORM_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1HX5kPVO6G982zOxH2BLv1FWexiITPnbjfWMN3a1M9yDtvw/formResponse';
const SHEET_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17HLtIdV3r55dIh06cSaWT8kFXzNrkR-Fu2ZJkjszG8k/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json';
const STATS_URL = 'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/api/quiz_stats.json';
let scoreSubmitted = false;

function resetLeaderboard() {
  scoreSubmitted = false;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Score'; btn.className = 'btn btn-lg'; btn.style.cssText = 'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff'; }
  const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  if (el) el.textContent = '';
}

// Mean confidence (0-100) across questions the participant rated in the
// CURRENT attempt. Returns null when no question was rated at all — the
// caller must guard on that and omit the field rather than send a bogus 0.
// The Google Form only accepts ONE confidence value per submission (no
// per-question repeat structure), so this attempt-level mean is the most
// granular thing that can be sent to the population Sheet; the real
// per-question confidences stay local (recordScoreHistory()/computeCalibration()).
function computeMeanConfidence() {
  const rated = S.confidences.filter(function(c) { return c !== null && c !== undefined; });
  if (rated.length === 0) return null;
  return rated.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / rated.length;
}

function submitScore(scorePct, nQuestions) {
  if (scoreSubmitted) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-lg'; }
  const data = new URLSearchParams();
  data.append('entry.335579146', scorePct);
  data.append('entry.2122920576', 100);
  data.append('entry.621716914', new Date().toISOString());
  data.append('entry.268026248', 'ranking');
  data.append('entry.232879816', S.selItems + 'items');
  data.append('entry.2010782223', nQuestions || '');
  const meanConf = computeMeanConfidence();
  if (meanConf !== null) data.append('entry.1681143871', Math.round(meanConf));
  fetch(FORM_URL, {method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body: data}).then(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Submitted!'; btn.className = 'btn btn-success btn-lg'; }
    getPercentile(scorePct);
  }).catch(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Score saved locally'; btn.className = 'btn btn-info btn-lg'; }
  });
}

function interpolatePercentile(scorePct, group) {
  const p = group.percentiles, s = group.scores_pct;
  for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (scorePct >= s[i]) return p[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function getPercentile(scorePct) {
  const meanConf = computeMeanConfidence();
  fetch(STATS_URL).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
  .then(stats => {
    const d = stats.ranking;
    if (!d) throw new Error('no ranking stats');
    let msg = 'You scored better than ' + interpolatePercentile(scorePct, d.overall) + '% of all players';
    msg += '! (' + d.overall.n + ' submissions)';
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = msg;
    renderCalibrationComparison(d.calibration, meanConf, scorePct);
  }).catch(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'Score submitted! Rankings unavailable right now.';
    // quiz_stats.json (the only source of population calibration data) was
    // unreachable here, so there is nothing to compare against — leave the
    // population calibration section hidden rather than showing a broken chart.
  });
}

// ---- Population confidence-calibration comparison (#132) ----
// SIMPLIFICATION: the population "calibration score" compared against here
// is a coarse, ATTEMPT-level approximation of a Brier-style error —
// (mean_confidence/100 - score_pct/100)^2 — computed server-side in
// plan_leaderboard_stats.R from the single confidence value the Form
// accepts per submission. It is not a true per-question Brier score (this
// quiz's per-question "outcome" is a continuous Kendall's Tau percentage,
// not a binary right/wrong); the real per-question version stays self-only
// (see computeCalibration() below and quiz_analytics.qmd's "Calibration"
// section, which already reads this quiz's local history generically).

// Generic descending-is-better percentile lookup: returns the percentile
// of the population whose value is <= `value` (population as-good-or-better
// than `value` when LOWER values are better, e.g. a calibration score).
function percentileOfAscending(value, percentiles, values) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) return 0;
  for (let i = values.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (value >= values[i]) return percentiles[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function renderCalibrationScatter(points, myConf, myScorePct) {
  const W = 320, H = 320, PAD = { l: 34, r: 12, t: 12, b: 32 };
  const innerW = W - PAD.l - PAD.r, innerH = H - PAD.t - PAD.b;
  function xPos(v) { return PAD.l + innerW * (Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)) / 100); }
  function yPos(v) { return PAD.t + innerH * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)) / 100); }

  const grid = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100].map(function(v) {
    const gx = xPos(v), gy = yPos(v);
    return '<line x1="' + PAD.l + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y2="' + gy + '" stroke="#2a2a4e" stroke-width="1"/>' +
           '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + PAD.t + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (H - PAD.b) + '" stroke="#2a2a4e" stroke-width="1"/>' +
           '<text x="' + (PAD.l - 4) + '" y="' + (gy + 3) + '" text-anchor="end" fill="#6677aa" font-size="9">' + v + '</text>' +
           '<text x="' + gx + '" y="' + (H - PAD.b + 12) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6677aa" font-size="9">' + v + '</text>';
  }).join('');

  // Perfect-calibration reference line (confidence == score)
  const diag = '<line x1="' + xPos(0) + '" y1="' + yPos(0) + '" x2="' + xPos(100) + '" y2="' + yPos(100) +
    '" stroke="#3a4e7c" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>';

  const popDots = points.map(function(p) {
    return '<circle class="chart-dot" cx="' + xPos(p.confidence_pct) + '" cy="' + yPos(p.score_pct) +
      '" r="3.5" fill="#5b9de5" fill-opacity="0.55"><title>Confidence ' + Math.round(p.confidence_pct) +
      '%, score ' + Math.round(p.score_pct) + '%</title></circle>';
  }).join('');

  const myDot = '<circle cx="' + xPos(myConf) + '" cy="' + yPos(myScorePct) +
    '" r="7" fill="#ffbe4d" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="1.5"><title>You: ' + Math.round(myConf) +
    '% confident, ' + Math.round(myScorePct) + '% correct</title></circle>';

  const axisLabels =
    '<text x="' + (PAD.l + innerW / 2) + '" y="' + (H - 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8899bb" font-size="10">Mean confidence (%)</text>' +
    '<text x="10" y="' + (PAD.t + innerH / 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8899bb" font-size="10" transform="rotate(-90 10 ' + (PAD.t + innerH / 2) + ')">Score (%)</text>';

  return '<svg class="history-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" style="width:100%;max-width:320px;display:block;margin:0 auto;">' +
    grid + diag + popDots + myDot + axisLabels + '</svg>';
}

function renderCalibrationComparison(dCalib, meanConf, myScorePct) {
  const section = document.getElementById('pop_calibration_section');
  const body = document.getElementById('pop_calibration_body');
  if (!section || !body) return;
  // No confidence rated this attempt -- nothing to compare, leave hidden.
  if (meanConf === null || meanConf === undefined) return;
  // Server hasn't computed ranking-quiz calibration stats yet -- leave hidden
  // rather than crashing on an undefined dCalib.
  if (!dCalib) return;

  const popN = (dCalib && dCalib.n) || 0;
  if (popN < 5) {
    section.style.display = '';
    body.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.85rem;">Not enough population confidence data yet ' +
      '(need 5+ rated attempts, have ' + popN + '). Check back soon!</p>';
    return;
  }

  const myCalibScore = Math.pow(meanConf / 100 - myScorePct / 100, 2);
  const q = dCalib.quantiles;
  const belowOrEqualPct = percentileOfAscending(myCalibScore, q.percentiles, q.calibration_scores);
  const betterThanPct = Math.max(0, 100 - belowOrEqualPct);

  section.style.display = '';
  body.innerHTML =
    '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.85rem;margin-bottom:0.75rem;">Your calibration score (' +
    myCalibScore.toFixed(3) + ') is better than ~' + Math.round(betterThanPct) + '% of the ' + popN +
    ' players who rated their confidence. Lower is better — 0 means your mean confidence exactly matched ' +
    'your score. This compares your <em>attempt-level</em> mean confidence against your score, a coarser ' +
    'measure than the per-question calibration in your local ' +
    '<a href="quiz_analytics.html">Quiz Analytics</a>.</p>' +
    renderCalibrationScatter(dCalib.points || [], meanConf, myScorePct);
}

// ---- Local score/confidence history (#132) ----
// Additive to the micromort_quiz_history schema shared with the other quiz
// variants ({date, type, score, correct, total}); confidences/outcomes are
// only added when at least one question was rated, so entries from other
// quiz pages are unaffected. This is browser-local only — no confidence
// data is sent to the Form/Sheet/leaderboard pipeline beyond the single
// attempt-level mean handled by submitScore()/computeMeanConfidence() above.
function recordScoreHistory(quizType, scorePct, score, total, confidences, outcomes) {
  const HISTORY_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_history';
  let hist;
  try { hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY) || '[]'); } catch (e) { hist = []; }
  const entry = { date: new Date().toISOString(), type: quizType, score: scorePct, correct: score, total: total };
  if (Array.isArray(confidences) && confidences.some(c => c !== null && c !== undefined)) {
    entry.confidences = confidences;
    entry.outcomes = outcomes;
  }
  hist.push(entry);
  if (hist.length > 200) hist = hist.slice(-200);
  try { localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(hist)); } catch (e) { /* localStorage unavailable/full */ }
}

function recordCompletedQuiz() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let totalPairs = 0, totalConc = 0;
  const outcomes = [];
  S.scores.forEach(function(sc) {
    if (sc) { totalPairs += sc.maxScore; totalConc += sc.score; outcomes.push(sc.pct / 100); }
    else { outcomes.push(null); }
  });
  const overallPct = totalPairs > 0 ? Math.round(totalConc / totalPairs * 100) : 0;
  recordScoreHistory('ranking', overallPct, totalConc, totalPairs, S.confidences, outcomes);
}

// Self-only calibration: predicted score (confidence-weighted expectation,
// as a percentage) and a Brier-style calibration error over the questions
// the participant rated a confidence for. ADAPTED from the acute quiz's
// computeCalibration(): that version compares confidence against a binary
// right/wrong outcome; this quiz's per-question "correctness" is the
// continuous Kendall's Tau percentage (sc.pct), so the "outcome" here is
// sc.pct / 100 rather than 0 or 1. The formula is otherwise identical —
// mean squared error between stated confidence and actual normalized score.
function computeCalibration() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rated = 0, predicted = 0, errSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const conf = S.confidences[i];
    const sc = S.scores[i];
    if (conf === null || conf === undefined || !sc) continue;
    const frac = conf / 100;
    const outcome = sc.pct / 100;
    predicted += frac;
    errSum += Math.pow(frac - outcome, 2);
    rated++;
  }
  return { rated, predictedPct: rated > 0 ? (predicted / rated * 100) : null, error: rated > 0 ? errSum / rated : null };
}

// ---- Result phrases ----
const PHRASES = [
  {min: 95, phrase: 'Risk ranking master!', fact: 'Combining acute and chronic risks onto one scale is the key insight of micromort/microlife theory.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Micromort'},
  {min: 90, phrase: 'Superb risk intuition!', fact: 'Comparing how much life you gain or lose lets us rank one-off events against daily habits.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Micromort'},
  {min: 80, phrase: 'Impressive ordering!', fact: 'People systematically overestimate rare dramatic risks and underestimate common ones.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_perception'},
  {min: 70, phrase: 'Better than most!', fact: 'The availability heuristic makes us judge risk by how easily we recall examples.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Availability_heuristic'},
  {min: 60, phrase: 'Getting there!', fact: 'Ranking risks correctly requires calibrating both magnitude and frequency.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_assessment'},
  {min: 50, phrase: 'About average!', fact: 'Even experts disagree on relative risk rankings in many domains.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_communication'},
  {min: 30, phrase: 'Tricky comparisons!', fact: 'Chronic daily habits can dwarf one-off acute risks when measured over a lifetime.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microlife'},
  {min: -1, phrase: 'Lots to discover!', fact: 'Understanding relative risk helps you focus on what actually matters.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Relative_risk'}
];
function getPhrase(pct) { return PHRASES.find(p => pct >= p.min) || PHRASES[PHRASES.length - 1]; }

const ENCOURAGEMENTS = [
  "Can you sort risks better than your gut instinct?",
  "Drag and drop your way to risk literacy.",
  "One-off dangers vs daily habits: which matters more?",
  "Your inner actuary wants to play. Let it.",
  "Warning: your risk rankings may surprise you.",
  "Micromorts meet microlives. Let the sorting begin.",
  "Think you know what's dangerous? Prove it.",
  "Some risks hide in plain sight. Can you spot them?"
];

// ---- Render functions ----
function render() {
  // Issue #142 (attempt 5): tie visibility of the pkgdown Source line /
  // Shinylive banner / site footer to actual quiz state, not DOM position.
  // pkgdown/extra.css hides them via body:has(#quiz-app):not(.quiz-results);
  // this class is set here, on every render(), so it always reflects S.phase.
  document.body.classList.toggle('quiz-results', S.phase === 'results_summary' || S.phase === 'results_detail');
  const app = document.getElementById('quiz-app');
  switch (S.phase) {
    case 'instructions': app.innerHTML = renderInstructions(); renderQR('qr-instructions', 3); break;
    case 'question': app.innerHTML = renderQuestion(); initSortable(); break;
    case 'results_summary': app.innerHTML = renderResults(); renderQR('qr-results', 3); break;
    case 'results_detail': app.innerHTML = renderDetail(); break;
  }
}

function renderInstructions() {
  const enc = ENCOURAGEMENTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ENCOURAGEMENTS.length)];
  const tagBtns = S.allTags.map(t =>
    `<span class="tag-btn${S.selTags.has(t) ? ' selected' : ''}" data-tag="${escHtml(t)}" onclick="toggleTag(this)">${escHtml(t)}</span>`
  ).join('');

  return `
    <div class="card"><div class="card-body">
      <ul class="mb-1">
        <li><b><em>Select one or more tags</em></b> below to choose which risk categories to quiz on.</li>
        <li><b><em>Drag and drop</em></b> to rank by risk to lifespan, biggest (top) to smallest (bottom).</li>
        <li>Rank by magnitude of factor (can be harmful or beneficial).</li>
        <li>Each risk shows how much life you <span class="risk-gain">gain ▲</span> or <span class="risk-lose">lose ▼</span> per exposure.</li>
        <li>Each correctly ordered pair scores a point (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kendall_rank_correlation_coefficient" target="_blank"><abbr title="Kendall rank correlation: counts how many pairs you ordered correctly vs incorrectly. Perfect = all pairs right.">Kendall's Tau</abbr></a>).</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="mb-1" style="padding-left:1.5em;"><em>${enc}</em></div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label" title="Select 1 or more risk categories. Click individual tags to toggle." style="cursor:help;text-decoration:underline dotted;">Tags</span>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">
          <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:4px;">
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="selectAllTags(true)">Select All</button>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="selectAllTags(false)">Deselect All</button>
          </div>
          <div id="tag_group" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;">${tagBtns}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label" title="Total number of ranking questions in this round." style="cursor:help;text-decoration:underline dotted;">Questions</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_nq">
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selNq=5;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">5</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selNq=10;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">10</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-center mt-3">
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="startQuiz()">Start Quiz</button>
      </div>
      <div id="qr-instructions"></div>
    </div></div>`;
}

function startQuiz() {
  if (S.selTags.size === 0) {
    alert('Please select at least one tag.');
    return;
  }

  // Group pool rows by question_id
  const byQ = {};
  quizPool.forEach(r => {
    if (!byQ[r.question_id]) byQ[r.question_id] = [];
    byQ[r.question_id].push(r);
  });

  // Filter: matching tags. Try 4 items first, fall back to 3.
  let candidates = Object.values(byQ).filter(items => {
    if (items.length !== 4) return false;
    return items.some(item => S.selTags.has(item.tag));
  });
  if (candidates.length < S.selNq) {
    // Not enough 4-item questions — also include 3-item
    const extra = Object.values(byQ).filter(items => {
      if (items.length !== 3) return false;
      return items.some(item => S.selTags.has(item.tag));
    });
    candidates = candidates.concat(extra);
  }

  if (candidates.length === 0) {
    alert('No questions match your selection. Try different tags.');
    return;
  }

  // Shuffle and pick n questions
  candidates = shuffle(candidates);
  const n = Math.min(S.selNq, candidates.length);
  S.nQuestions = n;
  S.questions = candidates.slice(0, n);
  S.userOrders = S.questions.map(items => shuffle(items.map((_, i) => i)));
  S.revealed = new Array(n).fill(false);
  S.scores = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.confidences = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.currentQ = 0;
  S.phase = 'question';
  render();
}

function renderQuestion() {
  const q = S.currentQ, n = S.nQuestions;
  const items = S.questions[q];
  const revealed = S.revealed[q];
  const userOrder = S.userOrders[q];
  const submitted = S.scores[q] !== null;
  const awaitingConfidence = submitted && !revealed;

  // Build rank items
  let rankHtml = '';
  if (!submitted) {
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mb-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&uarr;</span> Biggest effect</strong></div>';
    rankHtml += '<div id="sortable-list">';
    userOrder.forEach(idx => {
      const item = items[idx];
      const srcBadge = item.item_source === 'acute'
        ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>'
        : (item.microlives_per_day != null && item.microlives_per_day > 0
          ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#198754;color:#fff;">gain</span>'
          : '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>');
      rankHtml += `<div class="rank-item" data-idx="${idx}">
        <span class="drag-handle">\u2630</span>
        <span class="item-name">${formatName(escHtml(item.item_name))}</span>
        <div class="rank-badges">${srcBadge}<span class="badge bg-secondary">${escHtml(item.category)}</span></div>
      </div>`;
    });
    rankHtml += '</div>';
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mt-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&darr;</span> Smallest effect</strong></div>';
  } else if (awaitingConfidence) {
    // Submitted but not yet revealed: show the user's order locked (no drag
    // handle, no id="sortable-list" so Sortable.js does not re-attach), and
    // withhold correctness/score until confidence is captured.
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mb-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&uarr;</span> Biggest effect</strong></div>';
    userOrder.forEach(idx => {
      const item = items[idx];
      const srcBadge = item.item_source === 'acute'
        ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>'
        : (item.microlives_per_day != null && item.microlives_per_day > 0
          ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#198754;color:#fff;">gain</span>'
          : '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>');
      rankHtml += `<div class="rank-item" style="opacity:0.7;cursor:default;" data-idx="${idx}">
        <span class="item-name">${formatName(escHtml(item.item_name))}</span>
        <div class="rank-badges">${srcBadge}<span class="badge bg-secondary">${escHtml(item.category)}</span></div>
      </div>`;
    });
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mt-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&darr;</span> Smallest effect</strong></div>';
  } else {
    // Show correct order with green/red
    const correctOrder = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.correct_rank - b.correct_rank);
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mb-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&uarr;</span> Biggest effect (correct order)</strong></div>';
    correctOrder.forEach((item, correctIdx) => {
      const origIdx = items.indexOf(item);
      const userRankOfItem = userOrder.indexOf(origIdx);
      const isCorrectPos = (userRankOfItem === correctIdx);
      const cls = isCorrectPos ? 'rank-item rank-item-correct' : 'rank-item rank-item-wrong';
      const icon = isCorrectPos ? '\u2713' : '\u2717';
      const srcBadge = item.item_source === 'acute'
        ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>'
        : (item.microlives_per_day != null && item.microlives_per_day > 0
          ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#198754;color:#fff;">gain</span>'
          : '<span class="badge" style="background:#dc3545;color:#fff;">lose</span>');
      const userPosText = !isCorrectPos ? ` (you: #${userRankOfItem + 1})` : '';
      rankHtml += `<div class="${cls}">
        <span class="drag-handle">${icon}</span>
        <span class="item-name">${formatName(escHtml(item.item_name))}</span>
        <div class="rank-badges">${srcBadge}<span class="badge bg-secondary">${escHtml(item.category)}</span></div>
        <span class="lle-reveal"><span class="lle-tap" onclick="toggleLLEHelp(this)" title="Tap for details" style="cursor:help;">${lleDirLabel(item)}</span>${userPosText}</span>
      </div>`;
    });
    rankHtml += '<div class="rank-label mt-1"><strong><span class="rank-arrow">&darr;</span> Smallest effect</strong></div>';

    // Score for this question
    const sc = S.scores[q];
    if (sc) {
      rankHtml += `<div class="alert ${sc.pct >= 80 ? 'alert-success' : sc.pct >= 50 ? 'alert-warning' : 'alert-danger'} text-center mt-2 py-2">
        <strong>${sc.pct}%</strong> &mdash; ${sc.score}/${sc.maxScore} pairs correct
      </div>`;
    }
  }

  // Confidence capture (#132: self-only, no server persistence beyond the
  // single attempt-level mean sent by submitScore()). Shown once the
  // ranking is submitted, mirroring the acute quiz's per-question prompt.
  let confidenceHtml = '';
  if (awaitingConfidence) {
    const confOptions = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100];
    confidenceHtml = `<div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small class="text-muted d-block mb-1">How confident were you in that ranking?</small>
      <div class="option-btn-group justify-content-center" id="grp_conf">
        ${confOptions.map(pct => `<button class="option-btn" onclick="chooseConfidence(${pct}, this)">${pct}%</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  } else if (revealed && S.confidences[q] !== null && S.confidences[q] !== undefined) {
    confidenceHtml = `<div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small class="text-muted">Your confidence: <strong>${S.confidences[q]}%</strong></small>
    </div>`;
  }

  const diffBadge = (() => {
    const d = items[0].difficulty;
    if (!d) return '';
    const colors = {easy:'background:#198754;color:#fff', medium:'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff', hard:'background:#dc3545;color:#fff'};
    const style = colors[d] || 'background:#6c757d;color:#fff';
    return `<span class="badge me-2" style="${style}">${escHtml(d)}</span>`;
  })();

  // Tally (revealed-only, so the "so far" hint never leaks the current
  // question's correctness before confidence has been captured)
  let totalPairs = 0, totalConc = 0;
  S.scores.forEach((sc, i) => { if (sc && S.revealed[i]) { totalPairs += sc.maxScore; totalConc += sc.score; } });
  const answeredCount = S.revealed.filter(Boolean).length;
  const nextBtnClass = revealed ? 'btn btn-success' : 'btn btn-primary';

  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="prevQ()">&larr; Back</button>
      <span class="text-muted">${diffBadge}${q+1} of ${n} ${answeredCount > 0 ? '<small>' + Math.round(totalConc / totalPairs * 100) + '% so far</small>' : ''}</span>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;">
        ${!submitted ? '<button class="btn" style="background:#b85c0a;color:#fff" onclick="submitOrder()">Submit</button>' : ''}
        <button class="${nextBtnClass}" onclick="nextQ()">${q === n-1 ? 'Finish' : 'Next &rarr;'}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    ${rankHtml}${confidenceHtml}`;
}

function chooseConfidence(pct, el) {
  S.confidences[S.currentQ] = pct;
  S.revealed[S.currentQ] = true;
  render();
}

function initSortable() {
  const el = document.getElementById('sortable-list');
  if (!el) return;
  Sortable.create(el, {
    animation: 150,
    handle: '.drag-handle',
    ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
    onEnd: function() {
      // Update user order from DOM
      const items = el.querySelectorAll('.rank-item');
      S.userOrders[S.currentQ] = Array.from(items).map(item => parseInt(item.dataset.idx));
    }
  });
}

function submitOrder() {
  const q = S.currentQ;
  const items = S.questions[q];
  const userOrder = S.userOrders[q];

  // Correct order: sorted by correct_rank (1 = biggest effect)
  const correctOrder = items.map((_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => items[a].correct_rank - items[b].correct_rank);

  // Map to item names for scoring
  const userNames = userOrder.map(i => items[i].item_name);
  const correctNames = correctOrder.map(i => items[i].item_name);
  S.scores[q] = kendallTau(userNames, correctNames);
  render();
}

function nextQ() {
  if (S.currentQ < S.nQuestions - 1) { S.currentQ++; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'results_summary'; recordCompletedQuiz(); render(); }
}
function prevQ() {
  if (S.currentQ > 0) { S.currentQ--; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'instructions'; render(); }
}

function renderResults() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let totalPairs = 0, totalConc = 0;
  S.scores.forEach(sc => {
    if (sc) { totalPairs += sc.maxScore; totalConc += sc.score; }
  });
  const overallPct = totalPairs > 0 ? Math.round(totalConc / totalPairs * 100) : 0;
  const info = getPhrase(overallPct);
  const calib = computeCalibration();
  const calibHtml = calib.rated > 0 ? `
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-info"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Predicted (your confidence)</small><h2 class="mb-0">${calib.predictedPct.toFixed(0)}%</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-3">
      <small class="text-muted">Your calibration error: <strong>${calib.error.toFixed(3)}</strong> — lower is better calibrated (0 = perfect; adapted from a Brier score using your continuous ranking accuracy in place of a right/wrong outcome)${calib.rated < n ? ` · based on ${calib.rated}/${n} rated question${calib.rated === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}</small>
    </div>` : '';

  return `
    <h2 class="text-center mb-4">Results</h2>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-primary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Your Score</small><h2 class="mb-0">${overallPct}%</h2>
        <small>${totalConc}/${totalPairs} pairs</small>
      </div></div></div>
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-secondary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Random Ordering</small><h2 class="mb-0">~50%</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    ${calibHtml}
    <div class="analytics-section" id="pop_calibration_section" style="display:none;">
      <h3>Calibration vs. other players</h3>
      <div id="pop_calibration_body"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
      <h3>${info.phrase}</h3>
      <em>${info.fact}</em><br>
      <a href="${info.link}" target="_blank">Learn more &rarr;</a>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3">
      <button id="submit_btn" class="btn btn-lg" style="background:#b85c0a;color:#fff" onclick="submitScore(${overallPct},${n})">Submit Score</button>
      <button id="share_btn" class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="shareResult(${overallPct})">Share</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-lg" onclick="S.phase='results_detail';render()">View Details</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small id="percentile_text" class="text-muted"></small><br>
      <small class="text-muted">Scores are recorded anonymously (score, total, timestamp, and — if you rated any answers — your mean confidence for this attempt only).</small>
    </div>
    <div id="qr-results"></div>`;
}

function shareResult(pct) {
  const pEl = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  const pLine = pEl && pEl.textContent ? '\n' + pEl.textContent + '\n' : '\n';
  const text = '\ud83d\udcca Risk Ranking Quiz: I scored ' + pct + '%!' + pLine +
    'Rank lifespan risks.\n' +
    'Can you beat my score? \ud83d\udcca\n' +
    'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/articles/risk-ranking-quiz.html';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('share_btn');
    btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Share'; }, 2000);
  });
}

function renderDetail() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rows = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const items = S.questions[i];
    const sc = S.scores[i];
    const correctOrder = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.correct_rank - b.correct_rank);
    const correctNames = correctOrder.map(it => `${escHtml(it.item_name)} (${lleDirLabel(it)})`).join(' &gt; ');
    const userOrder = S.userOrders[i];
    const userNames = escHtml(userOrder.map(idx => items[idx].item_name).join(' > '));
    const pct = sc ? sc.pct + '%' : '\u2014';
    rows += `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td style="white-space:normal;max-width:300px;">${correctNames}</td>
      <td style="white-space:normal;max-width:300px;">${userNames}</td>
      <td>${pct}</td></tr>`;
  }
  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="S.phase='results_summary';render()">&larr; Back to Results</button>
      <h3 class="mb-0">Your quiz details</h3>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-scroll">
      <table class="table table-striped table-hover detail-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Q</th><th>Correct Order</th><th>Your Order</th><th>Score</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
}

// ---- Init ----
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  loadData();
  render();
});
</script>
```
